findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, get_feed_status, apply_feed_changes, deactivate_feed, reactivate_feed · Private data: create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, get_feed_status, apply_feed_changes, deactivate_feed, reactivate_feed · Public sink: apply_feed_changes · Destructive: get_feed, apply_feed_changes, reactivate_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, get_feed_status, apply_feed_changes, deactivate_feed, reactivate_feed · Private data: create_feed, list_feeds, get_feed, get_feed_status, apply_feed_changes, deactivate_feed, reactivate_feed · Public sink: apply_feed_changes · Destructive: get_feed, apply_feed_changes, reactivate_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
